notes: No SEC filings. All figures come from BYD's 2025 Annual Report on HKEXnews (published 27 March 2026), bilingual and prepared under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises, in RMB'000 (ISO CNY). OWNERSHIP is as at 31 December 2025 from the SFO Part XV registers. SHARE CAPITAL: in 2025 BYD issued 129,800,000 new H shares in a March 2025 placing and, under its 2024 profit distribution and capital reserve capitalization plan, 8 bonus shares and 12 capitalization shares for every 10 shares (implemented in 2025), so issued shares rose from 2,909,265,855 to 9,117,197,565; all share counts here are on the new basis. The report gives Wang Chuan-fu's A-share and H-share holdings separately as 16.90% and 0.03% of total issued share capital, so leader.derived combines them (16.93%); pctEconomic is null because no single total is stated. The 11,183,100 A shares he holds through the E Fund BYD No. 1 asset management plan are excluded, as in the report's own figure. No family total is disclosed. Xia Zuo-quan also holds 1,500,000 H shares (0.02%) not included in his 2.72%. JP Morgan Chase & Co.'s 2.18% H-share long position (including a 1.21% lending pool) is not listed. HKSCC Nominees is not used. DIVIDENDS: the 2024 final dividend paid in 2025 was RMB39.74 per 10 shares in cash, alongside the bonus issue. The retained-profits note line 'Cash dividends payable for ordinary shares' (RMB 14,508,500k) also includes the RMB 2,431,253k of retained profits capitalised as bonus shares, so the cash figure used is the net 'distribution to shareholders' in the equity statement (RMB 12,077,247k, the total-attributable column; the English row label there reads 'Distribution to other equity instruments holders' but the Chinese label and note reference are 'distribution to shareholders (note V.44)'). The cash-flow line 'Cash payments for distribution of dividends, profits or interest expenses' (RMB 14,125,279k) mixes dividends, interest, RMB 438,210k paid to minority shareholders and RMB 546,796k of interest to other equity holders, so it is not used. BUYBACKS: 'Increase of treasury stock' (RMB 3,985,206k), cash BYD paid to repurchase its own A shares for its employee equity incentive plans; Note V.41 labels the RMB 3,988,271k treasury-share increase 'Repurchase by equity incentive', and the MD&A says the Company did not 'otherwise' purchase its listed securities. They are kept as buybacks because BYD itself bought the shares (as for J&J's and Novartis's plan-related repurchases), not an employee trust; without them buybacks would be 0. This excludes RMB 3,622,378k 'Repurchase payments of minority interests', which concern equity in subsidiaries, not BYD's own shares. STOCK COMP: equity-settled share-based payment expense for the year (RMB 911,981k). GEOGRAPHY: operating revenue by customer location; overseas revenue rose to 38.7% of the total.

rnd.notes: Taxes: null. BYD reports under PRC accounting standards and its consolidated cash flow statement shows only 'Cash paid for various types of taxes' (RMB 53,801,954 thousand in 2025), which covers all taxes (VAT, surcharges etc.), not income tax alone; no cash income-tax-paid figure is disclosed. R&D: income-statement 'Research and development expenses' (expensed; capitalised development is excluded).

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended 31 December 2025 (BYD 2025 Annual Report on HKEXnews). Statements prepared under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CASBE), direct-method cash flow. Interest paid cannot be separated from dividends (null, not added), so paidOut omits cash interest to lenders. Operating cash inflows also include other income proceeds (mainly government subsidies) of 9,594,083 and tax rebates of 17,048,237 (both lower paidOut; not adjusted). Operating cash flow fell to 59,135,544 from 133,453,873 while capex rose to 156,807,853, so paidOut rose much faster than revenue. financeReceivablesInOCF left null: the statement does not show whether auto-finance receivables move through 'operating receivables'. Capex is the single combined CASBE line.
